MINI MINUTES: Appearance: Andrew Mayer Zachs, Esq. for Plaintiff
Edward Reidy, Trustee of the Olga Eugenia Lindemood Testamentary Trust, Plaintiff
Nancy Lawlor, Esq. for Defendant
Wayne Karsher, Defendant

This cause came on regularly as scheduled for settlement conference.
Parties met in chambers
Not settled, trial date confirmed.
Parties returned on Feb. 6, 2004 to settle the case.
Case settled. Written agreement and stipulation for entry of judgment was put on the record as follows:
Defendant waives right to seek stay of execution.
Each side to bear its own costs. Each side releases the other of all claims.
Defendant vacates premises located at: 2201 Baker St. SF, CA by 4/1/04.
Defendant will deliver keys to his counsel. Defendant's counsel will deliver keys to Plaintiff's counsel.
Plaintiff pays defendant the sum of $3,500 within 2 weeks of signing the agreement to be held in trust until 4/1/04.
Prior to 4/1/04, defendant may use the amount for housing and relocation costs.
If Defendant vacates pursuant to the terms of the agreement, Plaintiff shall dismiss this action with prejudice with-in 5 days of Defendant vacating the premises.
If Defendant fails to vacate, Plaintiff may, upon 24 hours notice to Defendant's counsel, seek ex parte entry of judgment.
Order was signed in open court
